_comment: VACANT night palettes. Each palette is four colours, shade 0 (darkest) to 3.
Shade 0 is shared by every palette so tiles of different palettes meet seamlessly.
GROUND, LAMP and SIGNAL share shade 1 (the 'ground family'); BUILD, WINDOW and NEON
share shade 1 with the current district's wall colour (the 'building family').
Shade 2 of a family palette is the 'lit surface' tone: a lamp quadrant turns the
pavement bevels warm, a neon quadrant turns wall highlights cyan.
The engine recomputes these at runtime for district tint, weather and fog.
